'''[[General/Legends|General]] Ennodius''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He and his people sided with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]]. He was the commander of [[Bunker Grek]], one of three underground Umbaran bases. A [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] later invaded Bunker Grek and defeated [[General/Legends|General]] Ennodius.
